descriptor.scene: The departing tenants are the subject: at dusk, a handful of small figures walk quietly away from the base of the hollow tower, seen from behind, each carrying a case or a bundle, spaced apart, nobody hurrying and nobody looking back. Behind them the tower's ground-floor doors stand shut, its windows mostly dark with only one or two lights left on high up. The mood is tender and quiet, a soft blue-and-gold dusk with long gentle shadows; no drama, no anger, no ruin, just leaving. The figures walk from the tower at the left of frame toward the open dusk plain at the right, small against the tall dark shape behind them. The lower right of the frame stays calm dusk grass.
negatives: faces visible on any figure (all are seen from behind)
slammed doors, broken windows or damage to the tower
descriptor._caption: The people who moved in move out. They leave the way trust leaves: quietly, no slam, just a door that does not open again. A floor can be rebuilt in a night. A tenant cannot.
